pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark regions with jagged, multi-lobated boundaries. Edge gradients are sharp, characterized by frequent indentations and non-linear paths.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes show clear convergence of three or more paths. Pathway thickness varies across the visible surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, bristled contour along the upper neck and shoulder with consistent low-amplitude jaggedness.
